note: Representative geographic reference points for the Immersive Globe prototype. These are approximate LOCATORS for orientation on a globe only. They are NOT the bounded study-area geometries, administrative boundaries, or route geometry used by the underlying research, and they carry no scientific meaning. FieldOS is a supporting instrument with no geographic location and is intentionally absent from this file. Per-point coordinate sources are recorded in SOURCES_AND_LICENSES.md.
geometry_disclaimer: representative_point — not study geometry, not a boundary, not a route

reference_points.label: Madrid — Atocha–Puerta de Alcalá corridor
reference_points.precision: City locator for central Madrid, in the vicinity of the Atocha–Puerta de Alcalá corridor.
reference_points.source_note: GeoNames approximate coordinates for Madrid city (ES). A city locator, not either frozen pedestrian route in the HATI source.

reference_points.label: Parque Nacional de la Sierra de Guadarrama
reference_points.precision: Design-only midpoint of the national park's published coordinate extremes; a bounding-box midpoint need not lie inside the park.
reference_points.source_note: Midpoint computed from MITECO national-park coordinate extremes. NOT a validated interior point, official centroid, PRUG zoning geometry, or asset location from the SNTO source.

reference_points.label: Western Mazandaran — Chalus, Nowshahr, Kelardasht
reference_points.precision: City locator for Chalus on the Caspian coast of northern Iran, standing in for the wider Chalus/Nowshahr/Kelardasht study region.
reference_points.source_note: OpenStreetMap gazetteer coordinates for Chalus city. NOT the reconstructed road-network geometry, gateway routes, or study extent in the CHALUS source.
